messages.author: c2a477445d711b46
messages.subject: Error calling function sys.source!
parts:
Hi there,

Can anyone help me understand what's wrong? We have successfully
configured two Linux boxes with Rapache. The third one is giving us
some headaches. In all honesty, we suspect it may have nothing to do
with Rapache, but I need help identifying the problem.

The Apache directive for the following tests is (RootDir is different
than /var/www):
ScriptAlias /RavianWeb/ "/var/www/RavianWeb/"
<Directory /var/www/RavianWeb>
SetHandler r-script
RHandler sys.source
</Directory>

Here are the tests - the results tell what was tested:
http://10.10.200.43/RavianWeb/test1.R
http://10.10.200.43/RavianWeb/test3.R
http://10.10.200.43/RavianWeb/test4.R
http://10.10.200.43/RavianWeb/test5.R

In a nutshell: Rapache returns the error when the R script attempts to
query a database (locally or remotely - last two tests). The script
works in either case if on the console. It uses RODBC on unixODBC to
query mysql databases (myodbc driver 5.1).

A more complex test shows a different error, but I bet stems from the
above. Try this:
http://10.10.200.43/RavianWeb/callRavian1.1.R?Process=Abundance&OutputType=XML&DataType=Band&level=0&obsSQL=CommonName='Golden-Crowned%20Sparrow'&eventSQL=ProjectCode='PALO'%20AND%20ProtocolCode='PALO_BAND'%20AND%20YearCollected%3C2005

Thanks for any insights you may have.

Leo

messages.author: c2a477445d711b46
messages.subject: Re: Error calling function sys.source!
parts:
Hello again,

Apologies for my previous post - cryptic and the machine is behind a
firewall, so unreachable to you all.
In a nutshell, this is what we have learned:

Using RODBC we are able to establish a connection but as soon as a
query is passed it causes a seg fault that kills the Apache thread.
If the same code is run on the console, it works.
Has anyone encountered this problem before?

The OS is Linux 5.3 (Tikanga) x64, with:
Apache 2.2.3
Rapache 1.1.8
R 2.9.2 - no other library loaded than RODBC and those loaded with
regular install
MySQL 5.1.32

What modules are known to conflict with mod_R.so?

Thanks for any help
Leo
